headline: Aurora 1.5: Extending open foundation models for weather and Earth-system applications

story_facts.headline: Aurora 1.5: Extending open foundation models for weather and Earth-system applications
story_facts.plain_language_summary: Aurora 1.5 adds 22 more variables, hourly temporal resolution, and probabilistic ensemble forecasting to the Aurora foundation model, making it more useful for real-world weather, climate, and energy applications. The post Aurora 1.5: Extending open foundation models for weather and Earth-system applications appeared first on Microsoft Research .
